subject: BrightBank: request for Secure SDLC artefacts and attestation
messages:
From: Elena Torres <e.torres@brightbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank SOC2 Team <soc2@brightbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Secure SDLC artefacts request for SIG questionnaire

Hi Marcus,

As part of our SIG intake and upcoming SOC 2 control mapping, the BrightBank security team needs a short package demonstrating Redwood's Secure SDLC controls. Specifically we're looking for: code review summaries (for critical repos), CI/CD pipeline controls diagram and brief description, secrets rotation/management policy and logs demonstrating rotation, and a change control/audit log covering 2025-2026.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-12)? If any items require an NDA or additional redaction we can accommodate — please flag.

Thanks,

Elena Torres
Principal Information Security Analyst
BrightBank
elena.torres@brightbank.com
(415) 555-0128
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <e.torres@brightbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Secure SDLC artefacts request for SIG questionnaire

Forwarding BrightBank's request — short deadline. Mina, Neha: can security & engineering assemble the artifacts Elena lists? Priority: code-review summaries for the main inference runtime repo and the CI/CD diagram. If anything contains PII or customer data we should redact; otherwise a DM-signed attestation will probably be fine.

I'll coordinate delivery and share the Drive link.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Secure SDLC artefacts request for SIG questionnaire

Thanks — tagging in engineering owners. Quick status:

- Code review summaries: we can produce aggregated PR review logs (author, reviewer, changelist summary) for the inference-runtime and orchestration repos covering 2026-01 to 2026-06. We'll redact any customer-specific diffs. Deliverable: code-review-summaries-2026-06.zip (contains CSV + index.html).
- CI/CD controls: pipeline diagram and short narrative describing gating, artifact immutability, and secrets access. Deliverable: cicd-pipeline-diagram-aug2026.png + cicd-controls.md.
- Secrets management: rotation policy and a snapshot of rotation events (redacted IDs) showing automated rotation cadence and last-rotation timestamps. Deliverable: secrets-rotation-playbook.pdf + rotation-extract.csv (redacted).
- Change control: audit export showing ticket links, merge approvals, and deployment records for 2025-2026. Deliverable: change-control-audit-log-2025-2026.csv (sanitized).

We will attach the artifacts to a restricted Drive folder and provide a short DM-signed attestation confirming the scope and redaction. ETA: I can have the first bundle uploaded by EOD today, full package by tomorrow EOD.

Questions: does BrightBank need pipeline run-level logs (very sensitive) or the higher-level controls summary?

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <e.torres@brightbank.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC artefacts request for SIG questionnaire

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Our security team confirms they will provide a redacted bundle and a DM-signed attestation.

Preview of what's coming:
- code-review-summaries-2026-06.zip (aggregated PR metadata; no customer diffs)
- cicd-pipeline-diagram-aug2026.png (diagram + gating narrative)
- secrets-rotation-playbook.pdf (policy + rotation evidence extract)
- change-control-audit-log-2025-2026.csv (sanitized audit export)

We'll upload to a restricted Google Drive and share a link, plus include a short statement of scope for your SIG intake. If you need raw pipeline logs or unredacted commits for a narrow scope, indicate that and we'll route through legal.

Best,
Marcus
From: Elena Torres <e.torres@brightbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank SOC2 Team <soc2@brightbank.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC artefacts request for SIG questionnaire

Marcus / Mina — appreciate the quick turnaround and scope notes. High level summary is fine for now; we do not need run-level logs unless the control mapping requires it. Please share the Drive link when the bundle is ready and we'll confirm receipt.

Regards,

Elena
